node.title: Budget-three fiber-two mismatch completion roots have a 24+6 invariant coupling
node.statement: For the generic canonical fiber-two cycle denominator-mismatch strata, the completion-root PGL coupling is root-permutation-free. If c=1, the four roots of D_* give exactly 24 candidate binary quartics, indexed by the ordered repeated-completion/residual-exceptional square pair and one relative sign. If c=2, they give exactly six candidates indexed by an unordered two-subset. Writing I=12ae-3bd+c^2 and J=72ace+9bcd-27ad^2-27b^2e-2c^3, a candidate matches the canonical outer quartic exactly when I_out^3 J_src^2=I_src^3 J_out^2. A passing class reconstructs its PGL_2(base field) map. No candidate is excluded and no matched norm gate is imported.
